stories.title: AMD is acquiring AI company World Labs in a deal worth more than $8 billion
stories.simple_summary: AMD, a computer chip company, is buying World Labs, an AI research company, for about $8 billion. World Labs is a newer company that makes AI programs that can create imaginary worlds or scenes.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech industry people — it doesn't directly change anything for regular small-business owners right now.

stories.title: Nvidia unveils security platform to stop AI agents from going rogue
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia (a big computer chip company) created new security tools to make sure AI agents (helpful computer programs that work on their own) don't do harmful things without permission.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use AI tools in your business, this makes them safer, but you probably won't notice the difference yourself.

stories.title: Contradicting Trump, Pope Leo says artificial intelligence safety concerns not 'fake news'
stories.simple_summary: A religious leader said that worries about AI safety are real concerns, not fake news, disagreeing with what a political leader said.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly about what leaders are saying — it doesn't change how AI actually works or affects your daily life.

stories.title: Shopify opens checkout to browser-based AI agents
stories.simple_summary: Shopify (an online store platform) now lets AI agents help customers finish buying things on their website, if the customer agrees to it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a Shopify store, you could eventually use AI to help customers complete purchases faster, but this is still new and just being rolled out.

stories.title: AI godfathers warn of runaway ‘intelligence explosion’
stories.simple_summary: Famous AI researchers are warning that AI could become so smart and powerful it might grow out of control in unexpected ways.
stories.why_it_matters: This is experts talking about future risks — nothing you need to worry about doing differently in your business today.

stories.title: Artificial intelligence is coming for Israel’s voters
stories.simple_summary: AI programs are being used to influence voters in Israel, like through targeted messages or fake information during elections.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a story about politics in another country — worth knowing about, but doesn't affect American small businesses.

stories.title: OpenAI’s AI agents need to catch up
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI (the company that made ChatGPT) has been slower than competitors at building AI agents that work on their own, but they might announce a new one soon.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors watching tech companies compete — not something that changes how you'd use AI in a small business.

stories.title: Nvidia launches new platform for reining in rogue AI agents
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia created new security tools and software to make sure AI agents that work independently stay safe and don't cause problems.
stories.why_it_matters: Similar to story #1 — this makes AI safer to use, but you probably won't notice the technical changes yourself.

stories.title: AI is supercharging hacking, and your local hospitals and banks aren’t ready
stories.simple_summary: Bad actors are using AI to hack into hospitals and banks more easily, and many of these organizations haven't set up good defenses yet.
stories.why_it_matters: If your business handles sensitive customer information or works in healthcare, you should check that your computer security is strong and up to date.

stories.title: Why AI Infrastructure Stocks Are Falling After OpenAI’s Latest Pause
stories.simple_summary: The stock prices of companies that build AI computer chips and hardware have dropped recently, possibly because of news about OpenAI's progress.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people with stock investments — unless you own these tech stocks, this doesn't affect your business.

stories.title: Trump Admin Is Reportedly Giving FOIA Requests an AI Makeover
stories.simple_summary: The Trump administration is starting to use AI to help process FOIA requests (formal requests for government documents from the public).
stories.why_it_matters: This might make getting government documents slightly faster, but probably won't impact most small-business owners.

stories.title: Anthropic releases Sonnet 5.5, which it calls a significantly cheaper, faster work partner
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic released a new version of its AI assistant that works faster and costs less money to use than before.
stories.why_it_matters: If you pay to use AI tools, you might save money, but this is mainly a tool for tech-savvy companies building AI products.
